name: Zooplankton (copepods and kin)
description: Small drifting crustacean grazers, chiefly copepods such as Acartia tonsa. Functional group aggregating the mesozooplankton community sampled by the source; in this estuarine network they take much of their carbon from suspended detritus and ciliates as well as phytoplankton. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the annual mean in mgC/m2.
